2. How often does it happen?

...... is a natural disaster that often happens in Viet Nam.
cac_cau.dap_an: Storms, which bring strong winds and heavy rain, are a common natural disaster in Viet Nam. Our country usually gets several of them a year. Most of them arrive between June and November. Before a storm comes, people need to make their houses stronger. They had better buy candles and batteries in case the power goes off. After the storm, people must wait for news from the local government before going out. Then they can repair their roofs and clear fallen trees from the roads. These simple steps can save lives and property.
